company.name: Pulley
company.shortDescription: Pulley is a developer of cap table management, communications hub, and fundraising modeling platforms to manage equity for startups.
company.description: Pulley is a company that provides a platform to help startup founders and employees figure out the equity. It also offers a cap table management product for startups to provide employee and investor equity information and maintain accurate ownership records. The platform is used to issue employee and investor equity and maintain accurate ownership records as the company scales. Pulley manages the cap table and runs the client's business with a clear understanding of the ownership of the business.

productsAndServices.description: A platform to manage startup equity ownership, including shares, options, and tokens, providing accurate and compliant cap table tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Cap Table Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: A tool to model fundraising rounds, issue SAFEs, and collect investor wires, streamlining the fundraising process for startups.
productsAndServices.name: Fundraising Management

productsAndServices.description: A service providing 409A valuations within five days and automating equity compliance tasks such as 83b elections and stock-based compensation reporting.
productsAndServices.name: 409A Valuation and Compliance Automation

productsAndServices.description: A system to issue equity grants to employees worldwide, supporting diverse ownership structures and enhancing employee ownership visibility.
productsAndServices.name: Global Equity Issuance

productsAndServices.description: A platform to manage token distributions and tax withholdings, integrating equity and token ownership in one system.
productsAndServices.name: Token and Crypto Equity Management
